summary: Opposes any cuts to E‑Rate funding, citing community reliance on library services for computers and Internet access.

claims.argument: Cutting E‑Rate funding would deny essential computer and Internet access to seniors and students who rely on library services.
claims.evidence_quote: Please do not cut funding. There are people in our community who cannot afford computers and/or the Internet and use our library for these services. Cutting funding would hurt both seniors and school
